description: This file is a Python script implementing a command-line tool for linting files with clang-format, including subprocess management, retries, and JSON output of lint messages.

classes.name: LintSeverity
classes.description: An enumeration of severity levels for lint messages (error, warning, advice, disabled).

classes.name: LintMessage
classes.description: A data structure representing a lint message with details such as path, line, severity, code, and description.

methods.name: as_posix
methods.description: Converts a filename to POSIX format, replacing backslashes with slashes on Windows.

methods.name: _run_command
methods.description: Executes a command with a timeout, capturing output and measuring execution time.

methods.name: run_command
methods.description: Retries running a command multiple times if it times out.

methods.name: check_file
methods.description: Checks a file with clang-format, returning lint messages if formatting differs or on errors.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for the command-line tool, parsing arguments and executing lint checks concurrently.
